File surface widened (2026-11-26T17:36Z) by one test file: `packages/rest/src/meta-item-version-token-occ.test.ts`. One case there pins the refusal this card removes (save draft d1, publish it unchanged, save a new draft with d1's token → asserts 409 `currentVersion: null`); after publish the token names the current published row, so card acceptance 1 says it must be accepted. The case splits in two: (a) a token naming the current published body writes the draft; (b) after the published row changes, the old token is refused 409 `METADATA_CONFLICT` naming the current published version, then `If-None-Match: *` writes the draft. Tests only; no `packages/rest/src` code.
